brand.purpose: Used beside the text-free interlocking-circle mark.

shadows.name: window-lift
shadows.purpose: Authentication cards and true floating overlays, never the app shell.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, focus and active state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height:32px; padding:0 12px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:var(--primary); color:var(--primary-foreground); font:500 13px/1 var(--font-ui); transition:background 150ms cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1),transform 150ms cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--renderer-accent-pressed); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height:32px; padding:0 12px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:var(--transparency-block); color:var(--text-primary); font:500 13px/1 var(--font-ui); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:var(--transparency-hover); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Product Input
components.html: <input class="ds-input" value="资料交付顺序" aria-label="任务名称" />
components.css: .ds-input { height:32px; min-width:240px; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid var(--line-1); border-radius:6px; background:var(--transparency-block); color:var(--text-primary); font:400 13px/1 var(--font-ui); } .ds-input:hover { background:var(--transparency-hover); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:var(--primary); outline:2px solid var(--border-focus); outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Active Navigation
components.css: .ds-nav-active { height:34px; padding:0 10px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:var(--accent-bg); color:var(--primary); font:500 13px/1 var(--font-ui); } .ds-nav-active:hover { background:var(--transparency-active); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; height:20px; padding:0 7px; border-radius:4px; background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--state-success) 12%,var(--background-panel)); color:var(--state-success); font:500 11px/1 var(--font-ui); } .ds-status i { width:5px; height:5px; border-radius:50%; background:currentColor; }

components.name: Composer
components.description: Primary work surface for a new request.
components.html: 工作空间 · 自动检索
components.css: .ds-composer { width:440px; padding:6px 0 8px; border:1px solid var(--line-1); border-radius:16px; background:var(--background-fronted); box-shadow:0 2px 8px oklch(0.25 0.03 268 / .08); } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color:var(--primary); outline:2px solid var(--border-focus); } .ds-composer textarea { display:block; width:100%; min-height:72px; padding:12px 14px; border:0; resize:none; background:transparent; color:var(--text-primary); font:400 14px/1.7 var(--font-ui); } .ds-composer > div { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:0 10px; color:var(--text-secondary); font:400 11px/1 var(--font-ui); } .ds-composer button { width:32px; height:32px; border:0; border-radius:50%; background:var(--primary); color:var(--primary-foreground); } .ds-composer button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview: A calm, verifiable workbench where color marks action and state rather than decorating AI. Paiban combines stable cool-neutral surfaces with a text-free interlocking-circle mark and rare collaboration sparks.

rules.name: Rare Color Rule
rules.body: Saturated color carries no more than roughly ten percent of a screen's visual weight.

rules.name: Flat-by-default Rule
rules.body: Use spacing, tone and dividers before shadow.

dos: Use text and icons alongside semantic color.
Keep message and evidence content visually dominant.
Preserve Tutti keyboard and component behavior.
donts: Do not return to an all-gray anonymous AI console.
Do not use neon gradients or decorative glassmorphism.
Do not clone Kimi brand assets or layout pixels.
Do not wrap every piece of information in an identical card.
